author: Adventurous-Car8603
body:
Volley 1/2 can be fantastic skills to spam at your tier, if you are not dying too easily. The ones with negative ward could hurt against stronger opponents though. Get blight or arcane arrows for the upgraded volley 2 skill. Or if you were lucky enough to get the hels feathers even better as they have positive ward with volley 2. Clurichaun arrows have no ward but come with volley 2 as well. There is also badbs feathers with volley 2.


At higher tiers volley skills arent used much as you either build ward or crit based attacks for melee classes and arrows/volley does work towards either.

author: Widogeist
body:
As with other multi-hit attacks, volley has no penetration. This means if you go against an enemy with very high defense (in comparison to your attack stat) volley will do little to no damage compared to other abilities that have penetration. If you're still doing good damage and it's working well, then keep using it. Once you get into higher tiers, volley will lose its effectiveness and you'll need to switch it up.

As a side note, if you dual wield weapons and use a bow in your offhand slot you still have access to the volley ability. This might be a better idea than using T3 arrows at T7; you'll have more attack, and you'll also get rid of the ward penalty on the arrows.
